english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for similarity or resemblance.
Use this for a measured or general degree of visual resemblance, especially in comparisons or technical contexts.

examples.english: The likeness between these two photos is very high; they really look alike.
examples.traditional: 呢兩張相嘅相似度好高，真係幾似樣。
examples.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zoeng1 soeng2 ge3 soeng1 ci5 dou6 hou2 gou1 zan1 hai6 gei2 ci5 joeng6

examples.english: The similarity between these two photos is ninety percent.
examples.traditional: 呢兩張相嘅相似度有九成。
examples.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zoeng1 soeng2 ge3 soeng1 ci5 dou6 jau5 gau2 sing4
